dialogues.jp: 「好きです」
dialogues.en: "I do."
dialogues.text: "I do."

dialogues.jp:
重たい視線がぶつかってくる。俺は、それをしっ
かりと受け止めた。
dialogues.en: Her serious gaze was fixated on me, but I did not back down.
dialogues.text: Her serious gaze was fixated on me, but I did not back down.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「本気ね？」
dialogues.en: "Are you serious about it?"
dialogues.text: "Are you serious about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
さっき、工藤とことりとが妙に仲良くしている
のを見て、何かが痛んだのは──このせいだ。
dialogues.en:
Earlier, when Kudou and Kotori were talking like they were
so close, that pain I felt-- this must've been the cause.
dialogues.text:
Earlier, when Kudou and Kotori were talking like they were
so close, that pain I felt-- this must've been the cause.

dialogues.jp: 今なら、はっきりと言える。
dialogues.en: I can plainly say it now.
dialogues.text: I can plainly say it now.

dialogues.jp: 「俺はことりが好きなんです」
dialogues.en: I like Kotori."
dialogues.text: I like Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
腕を組み、ソファーに身体を預けると、暦先生
はじっと天井を見つめた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei crossed her arms, leaned back on the sofa, and
stared at the ceiling, thinking.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei crossed her arms, leaned back on the sofa, and
stared at the ceiling, thinking.

dialogues.jp:
なみなみと注がれたコーヒーに口を付ける。ぬ
るくなっていた。
dialogues.en:
I continued sipping my coffee as normal. It had grown
lukewarm.
dialogues.text:
I continued sipping my coffee as normal. It had grown
lukewarm.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……本気で好きなら、いい」
dialogues.en: "...If you're serious about it, then it's fine."
dialogues.text: "...If you're serious about it, then it's fine."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「私だって、妹の恋愛は応援したいしね」
dialogues.en: "Since that's the case, I'd support my sister's love."
dialogues.text: "Since that's the case, I'd support my sister's love."

dialogues.jp:
反動を付け身体を起こすと、ぐっと身を乗り出
してきた。
dialogues.en: As if kicked from behind, I leaned forward in reaction.
dialogues.text: As if kicked from behind, I leaned forward in reaction.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉、だったら、明日から、ことりの看病を
　しなさい」
dialogues.en: "So tomorrow, make sure you come over and look after her."
dialogues.text: "So tomorrow, make sure you come over and look after her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "...Haah?"
dialogues.text: "...Haah?"

dialogues.jp:
コーヒーを吹き出しそうになるのを、何とか堪
えた。
dialogues.en: I was blowing at my coffee as she proclaimed that.
dialogues.text: I was blowing at my coffee as she proclaimed that.

dialogues.jp: 「な、何でです？」
dialogues.en: "W, what do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "W, what do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「だから、言ったでしょう。妹の恋愛は、応援
　したいって」
dialogues.en: "I just told you. I'd support my sister's love."
dialogues.text: "I just told you. I'd support my sister's love."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それに、現実問題、あたしもそうそう休むわ
　けにはいかないからね。両親も仕事があるし」
dialogues.en:
"And besides, there's a real problem here. I can't take so
many days off work, and our parents are both working as
well."
dialogues.text:
"And besides, there's a real problem here. I can't take so
many days off work, and our parents are both working as
well."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「体調の悪い妹を、一人家に置いておくのも、
　ほんとは心苦しいのよ。その点、朝倉が居て
　くれれば安心だ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want to leave her alone right now, especially when
she's so weak. If you're around, I'd feel a lot better."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want to leave her alone right now, especially when
she's so weak. If you're around, I'd feel a lot better."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、それに君なら、見境なくすって事もなさ
　そうだし」
dialogues.en:
"That is, as long as you do care about not leaving her alone
as well."
dialogues.text:
"That is, as long as you do care about not leaving her alone
as well."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんなの当たり前じゃないですか！」
dialogues.en: "O, of course I do!"
dialogues.text: "O, of course I do!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、決まりでいいね？」
dialogues.en: "Then it's decided, no?"
dialogues.text: "Then it's decided, no?"

dialogues.jp:
にっと笑う。その唇の角度に、つり込まれるよ
うにうなずいてしまった。
dialogues.en: A wolfish grin. I couldn't say anything in response.
dialogues.text: A wolfish grin. I couldn't say anything in response.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「偉い。それでこそ、朝倉だ」
dialogues.en: "Excellent, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Excellent, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 何の事やら。
dialogues.en: What's going on?
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ、その旨ことりに伝えておくから。
　嫌そうだったら、あたしから電話する」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I'd call you later to tell you when to come. Kotori
doesn't like to use the telephone."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I'd call you later to tell you when to come. Kotori
doesn't like to use the telephone."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
いつものように、練習を見るために家を出たの
に、ことりを看病する事になるなんて……。
dialogues.en:
It's not that I'd rather go to practice than to look after
Kotori while she's sick.
dialogues.text:
It's not that I'd rather go to practice than to look after
Kotori while she's sick.

dialogues.jp:
何か、いつもの電車に乗ったはずが、まるで別
の場所に運ばれてしまったような気分だった。
dialogues.en: But it is an awfully long trip by train both ways...
dialogues.text: But it is an awfully long trip by train both ways...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、そしたら、帰った帰った。あたしも何
　かと忙しいんだから」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, hurry up and go back already. I have things to do."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, hurry up and go back already. I have things to do."

dialogues.jp:
追い立てるような言葉に、俺は慌ててカップを
傾けた。
dialogues.en:
Being chased out of the house, I confusedly returned her
cup.
dialogues.text:
Being chased out of the house, I confusedly returned her
cup.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしはね、ことりの事が本当に好きなんだ。
　ほんとに、大事に思ってる」
dialogues.en: "I really love Kotori. She's an important person to me."
dialogues.text: "I really love Kotori. She's an important person to me."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「だから、泣かせるような真似したら、承知し
　ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"So don't think I'd accept it easily if you ever make her
cry."
dialogues.text:
"So don't think I'd accept it easily if you ever make her
cry."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「肝に銘じておきます」
dialogues.en: "My life is in your hands."
dialogues.text: "My life is in your hands."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ん。いい答えだ……授業もそれくらい出来れ
　ばねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Mm, good answer... at least you remember something from
your lessons."
dialogues.text:
"Mm, good answer... at least you remember something from
your lessons."

dialogues.jp:
普段のような軽口に、俺はホッと全身の緊張を
解いた。
dialogues.en:
Returning to her usual talkative self, all the tension in my
body was released somehow.
dialogues.text:
Returning to her usual talkative self, all the tension in my
body was released somehow.

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、失礼します」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'd take my leave now."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'd take my leave now."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「気をつけてな」
dialogues.en: "Be careful."
dialogues.text: "Be careful."

dialogues.jp: 頭を下げ、俺はその場を後にした。
dialogues.en:
Bowing my head, I prepare to return to this place in the
future.
dialogues.text:
Bowing my head, I prepare to return to this place in the
future.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりが好き◆
dialogues.en: ◆I like Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆I like Kotori◆

dialogues.jp: 好きだと答えた。
dialogues.en: I answered that I like her.
dialogues.text: I answered that I like her.

dialogues.jp:
すると暦先生は、ことりの看病を俺にしろと言
う。断る理由もないので、俺は承諾した。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei then set me up to look after her tomorrow. I
had no reason to decline, so I consented to it.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei then set me up to look after her tomorrow. I
had no reason to decline, so I consented to it.
